title: Pure vs eBay for U.S. Mint Releases (2026)
summary: Compare Pure and eBay for U.S. Mint releases in 2026: seller fees of 1.5% vs 13.25%, authenticity verification, payout speed, and release-day selling.
body_markdown:
**Pure and eBay are the two main places to buy and sell U.S. Mint releases after they sell out. Pure charges sellers 1.5% or less and physically verifies every coin before delivery. eBay charges 13.25% plus fees on shipping and sales tax, and does not physically inspect coins. eBay wins on reach, auctions, and raw or world coins.**


The stakes are real. The 2026 Semiquincentennial Silver Proof Set sold out on June 11, and within days sets were[selling on eBay for $310 to $349.95](https://collectpure.com/blog/what-happens-when-a-us-mint-coin-sells-out) , roughly 33% over the Mint's issue price. Where you buy or sell decides how much of that price you keep, whether the coin is genuine, and how long you wait.


*Disclosure: Pure operates the Pure marketplace. All eBay fees and policies were checked against eBay's published pages on July 7, 2026, and every claim links to its source.*

## Which is cheaper for selling U.S. Mint coins: Pure or eBay?


**Collect Pure is cheaper. Selling a $1,000 U.S. Mint coin costs about $15 on Pure and about $142 on eBay without a store subscription.** Here is the math on a $1,000 sale with free shipping where the buyer pays $70 in sales tax:


-


**eBay, no store:** the[final value fee for Coins & Paper Money is 13.25%](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/fees-credits-invoices/selling-fees?id=4822) of the total sale including shipping and sales tax. 13.25% of $1,070 plus a $0.40 order fee = **$142.18** , or 14.2% of the sale price.


-


**eBay, Basic Store:** the category rate drops to[9%](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/fees-credits-invoices/store-selling-fees?id=4809) , so $96.70, plus the $21.95 to $27.95 monthly subscription.


-


**eBay Promoted Listings:** ad fees start at 2% of the sale and stack on top of the final value fee.


-


**Pure:** the numismatic seller fee[starts at 1.5%](https://collectpure.com/blog/pure-selling-tiers) and falls to 1.0% with quarterly volume. On $1,000 that is **$15.00** . Shipping to Pure uses prepaid, insured FedEx labels.


Bullion rates follow the same pattern. eBay's bullion subcategory charges[13.6% on sales of $7,500 or less and 7% above that](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/fees-credits-invoices/selling-fees?id=4822) without a store. Pure charges 0.75% for gold bullion and 1.00% for silver, platinum, and palladium at the entry tier.


## How do Pure and eBay handle authenticity?


**eBay does not physically inspect coins. Pure physically verifies every order at its Los Angeles facility before it reaches the buyer.**


Coins are excluded from[eBay's Authenticity Guarantee](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/selling-tools/ebay-authenticity-guarantee?id=4644) , which covers watches, sneakers, handbags, trading cards, jewelry, and apparel. What coins get instead is a set of listing rules under the[collectible currency policy](https://www.ebay.com/help/policies/prohibited-restricted-items/collectible-currency-policy?id=4337) :


-


Graded coins must come from approved companies (PCGS, NGC, ANACS, ICG, CAC, and a few others)


-


Raw coins cannot show a numeric grade or list at $2,500 or more


-


Listings must photograph the actual coin, and since[mid-June 2026](https://www.ebay.com/sellercenter/news/2026-june) must include standardized condition details


Rules are not inspection. In May 2026, NBC Connecticut[bought four American Silver Eagles from eBay sellers and all four tested as counterfeit](https://www.nbcconnecticut.com/investigations/nbc-ct-responds/we-tested-silver-coins-bought-on-ebay-and-they-were-all-fake/3738194/) . Many eBay coin dealers are reputable; the buyer carries the burden of telling them apart.


On Pure, every order passes through[Pure's Los Angeles verification facility](https://collectpure.com/blog/how-the-pure-marketplace-works) , where items are checked with XRF and a Sigma Metalytics precious-metal verifier, and certified coins are run through proprietary scanning. Pure states verification typically takes about 24 hours, and authenticity is guaranteed: if something is wrong, Pure takes the product back.


## How does selling a U.S. Mint release work on each platform?


**On eBay you build a listing and wait for a buyer. On Pure the market already exists before release day, and you sell into it the day your coin arrives.**


**Selling on eBay:**


1.


List after the coin arrives, or presale-list under[eBay's presale policy](https://www.ebay.com/help/policies/listing-policies/presale-listings-policy?id=4252) : "presale" in the title and description, a stated ship date, and guaranteed shipment within 40 business days


2.


Photograph the coin, write the listing, and price it against scattered comps


3.


When it sells, pack and ship it to the buyer yourself


4.


Carry Money Back Guarantee exposure if the Mint delays your order


**Selling on Pure:**


1.


U.S. Mint products are[listed on the order book before release](https://collectpure.com/blog/2026-us-mint-product-release-details-american-buffalo-2026-one-ounce-gold-proof-coin-26el) , so funded bids are visible before the Mint's sale opens


2.


When your Mint box arrives, accept the highest bid or post your own ask. No photos, no listing copy


3.


Ship the[sealed Mint box, original packaging intact](https://collectpure.com/blog/how-to-pack-and-ship-your-items-to-pure-us-mint-edition) , with a prepaid, insured FedEx label


4.


Pure verifies the item and forwards it to the buyer


Pure is not a presale venue: you transact once the coin is in hand. The[order sheet](https://www.collectpure.com/order-sheet) shows live bid, ask, spread, and depth for every listed release. Demand moves fast: when the 2021 Morgan Dollars dropped,[175,000 coins sold out in about 25 minutes](https://coinweek.com/recent-articles-video/first-2021-morgan-dollars-sell-out-in-minutes/) .


## How fast do you get paid?


**Pure releases payment after verification, typically arriving in 1 to 3 business days by ACH. eBay funds clear in 1 to 2 days plus a payout schedule, and new sellers face holds of 3 to 31 days.**


-


**eBay established sellers:** proceeds typically take[1 to 2 days to become available](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/getting-paid/getting-paid-items-youve-sold?id=4814) , then pay out on schedule with 1 to 3 business days of bank clearing


-


**eBay new sellers:**[holds apply](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/getting-paid/payout-hold?id=4816) : funds release about 3 days after delivery with an eBay label, 7 days with a third-party label, or 31 days after payment if untracked


-


**Pure:** payout releases once the item passes verification, regardless of seller tenure


-


**Pure Advanced Payment (beta):** the full amount[advances within 24 hours of package delivery](https://collectpure.com/blog/new-selling-feature-advanced-payment) for a 0.5% to 1.25% fee


## Which is better for buying a U.S. Mint release after it sells out?


**eBay offers more listings faster; Pure offers verified coins, no marketplace fee, and the whole market on one page.**


-


**Selection:** eBay has dozens of listings within hours of a sellout, plus familiar sold-listings history. Pure shows every resting bid and ask for the product on a single order book page


-


**Cost:** eBay buyers pay item price plus shipping plus sales tax. Pure buyers pay no marketplace fee; orders under $10,000 carry $25 shipping, bank transfers are free, and a 2.9% card surcharge applies only to[Pure Priority](https://collectpure.com/blog/introducing-pure-priority) items, which are pre-verified and ship within 1 to 3 business days


-


**Protection:** on eBay, coins get a shortened[Money Back Guarantee window](https://www.ebay.com/help/policies/ebay-money-back-guarantee-policy/ebay-money-back-guarantee-policy?id=4210) : not-as-described claims must be filed within 3 calendar days of delivery if the seller offers no returns, versus 30 days for most goods. On Pure, every item is verified before it ships to you


## When is eBay the better choice?


**eBay is the better platform for anything outside modern U.S. Mint products, certified coins, and bullion.** Specifically:


-


**Raw and ungraded coins** (under eBay's $2,500 raw-coin cap), world coins, ancient coins, tokens, and paper currency, none of which fit Pure's catalog


-


**Auctions** for rare pieces with no established market price


-


**International buyers and sellers** : Pure is U.S. only


-


**Sold-comps history** the whole hobby uses as a reference


## Verdict: which should you use?


**For modern U.S. Mint releases, Pure costs roughly one-tenth of eBay's fees, verifies every coin, and pays out without tenure-based holds. For everything else in numismatics, eBay remains the default.** Selling a $1,000 Mint product costs about $15 on Pure versus about $142 on eBay without a store subscription, and a sealed Mint box can sell into a live bid the day it arrives. If you have a Mint release on the way,[here is how selling on Pure works](https://collectpure.com/blog/how-to-sell-on-pure-marketplace) , and the[order sheet](https://www.collectpure.com/order-sheet) shows what bids look like right now.


## Frequently asked questions


### Does eBay's Authenticity Guarantee cover coins?


No. As of July 2026, eBay's Authenticity Guarantee covers watches, sneakers, handbags, trading cards, jewelry, and apparel. Coins fall under eBay's collectible currency policy, which sets listing rules but includes no physical inspection.


### What does eBay charge to sell coins in 2026?


eBay charges 13.25% of the total sale, including shipping and sales tax, up to $7,500 per item, plus $0.30 to $0.40 per order. Bullion runs 13.6%, or 7% above $7,500. A Basic Store lowers coins to 9%. Current as of July 7, 2026.


### What does Pure charge to sell a U.S. Mint release?


Pure seller fees start at 1.5% for numismatic items, 1.00% for silver, platinum, and palladium, and 0.75% for gold bullion, decreasing with quarterly volume. Shipping to Pure uses prepaid, insured FedEx labels, and buyers pay no marketplace fee.


### Can I list a U.S. Mint release on eBay before it arrives?


Yes. eBay's presale policy requires "presale" in the title and description, a stated ship date, and guaranteed shipment within 40 business days. On Pure, the order book opens before release day so bids are visible, but you sell once the coin is in hand.


### How fast do I get paid after selling a Mint release?


On Pure, payment releases after verification and typically arrives within 1 to 3 business days by ACH, with an optional Advanced Payment feature funding within 24 hours of delivery. On eBay, funds clear in 1 to 2 days plus your payout schedule, and new sellers face holds of 3 to 31 days.


### Is it safe to buy U.S. Mint coins on eBay?


It can be, from established sellers. But coins are excluded from eBay's Authenticity Guarantee, a May 2026 NBC Connecticut test found all four Silver Eagles it purchased were counterfeit, and not-as-described claims on coins must be filed within 3 days of delivery if the seller offers no returns. Pure verifies every item before delivery.
